notes.title: NEW! Venture Valley Game Update - May 22
notes.notes:
Venture Valley Version 0.1.451 has arrived in the Apple App Store, Google Play Store and Steam! We’re excited to bring you a brand new upgrade to the Marketing in Venture Valley on top of the usual bug squashing and performance improvements.

New Features:
– Marketing Update: Make Marketing Magic by using new marketing tools like billboards, TV ads and even Influencers! Marketing is now a timed boost rather than an editable lever.
 
Changed:
– Blocking loan popup data when business has no loan

– Marketing is now a timed boost rather than an editable lever

– Marketing tutorial to cover the new products

– Removed scrolling dialogue text

– Removed submarine from drone cargo options

– Changed R&D card descriptions

Fixed:
– Beanie accessory available before unlock

– Property values exceeding box limits

– Lightning storm card fx now plays for correct duration

– Multiple name change popups blocking each other

– Rapidly adding cards causes some cards to not get added

– Spamming rank up causes hardlock error

– Hijab not having color applied

– Another popup appearing whilst one is loading

– Gelato trucks causing tear across screen

– Cash Crash card being unlocked from start yet being present in level rewards

– Disabling loan button if business is already built

– Blocking other marketing options when one is pending

– Moved no internet popup earlier in flow

notes.title: NEW! Venture Valley Game Update
notes.notes:
Venture Valley Version 0.1.440 has arrived in the Apple App Store, Google Play Store and Steam! We’re excited to bring you HUGE game updates including a brand new Daily Login Bonus system, XP Bonuses and more on top of the usual bug squashing and performance improvements.

New Features:

– Daily Login Bonus – Play Venture Valley every day consecutively to put extra $$$ in your wallet!

– XP Rewards – Earn XP to unlock exclusive new cards, avatar accessories and in-game cash with our new game rewards.

– New HQ Options – New ways to upgrade and show off your HQ so that everyone can see what being the Boss buys you!

Also Added:

– More analytics data events

– Added arrows to level reward ceremony when more than one reward

– New icons for daily login bonus

– Level reward ui and functionality

– Tool to allow specifying meep accessories that can show with other accessories

– Server maintenance popup

– Loan data to monthly expenses popup

– Local notification scheduler

– Added missing Accessories to the avatar generator

– Added missing Unique Id’s to VR Goggles

 

Changed:

– Changed the unlock requirements for HQ’s

– Removed tutorial step in Mutts and Putts

– Foreclosure down to 2 months from 4

– Changed the unlock requirements for HQ’s

– Allowed the player to exit from the settings menu during Fortune Springs 1

– Changed trophy animation to be faster

– Removed card unlocks from brickyard_1

– Added the word Base into card description to better reflect their affect

– Added to the loan tutorial to address the changes of the new feature

– HQ unlocks to be more based on net worth

 

Fixed:

– HQ not unlocking for existing accounts

– Correcting daily loan payment amount

– First tutorial after cutscene not playing

– Dialogue is now present when Ira and Eileen appear in The Ultimate Showdown level

– Level rewards at the end of match are not clickable untile the xp animation is done

– Meep not entering bio enhancement level 2 door

– FTUE card title to “Featured Cards”

– Removed floating glass asset from the Change Avatar options

– Turned off certain accessories which had clipping issues with the Star Buns hair

– Checking for newly unlocked items in shop to show pips on

– Moved the chin sloth beard forward a little and fixed the see through clipping on the right side

– Moved the squared glasses forward and widened the sides a little to better fit the hat, mask and hairstyles

– Made the lenses slightly bigger on the crazy glasses to prevent flickering when they rotate

– Moved the Face sloth 2nd beard forward a little to prevent clipping with the face

– Made the lenses rounded on the star glasses to show the specular shine on them in game

– Made the glasses fit better around the head to match hair assets better

– Pulled the goggles away from the face and made the sides wider to alow for more hairstyles to work

– Determined any obvious clipping issues between avatar assets and ensured they can no longer be selected together by the player

notes.title: Major Update Incoming!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38827951/c9e4fc73221c094b96568ecc310ddd43cb4e1c71.png

Get ready for some big changes coming to Venture Valley! 


 Introducing the new Solo mode, a completely new way to play the game!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38827951/7acd2d5defd559449a09c382579440fb55bc671b.png
 You can now customize multiplayer matches to be short competitive games or long grinding battles of the minds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38827951/4bdf7b4956cc8266eae5d33d7e55c80f344069b1.png
 Say goodbye to the old look, Venture Valley has upgraded and improved the visuals to enhance your experience!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38827951/4119861959788e90b8ba9696e089099da37d55c2.png
 Because of all of the new updates, players will have to reactivate their accounts. Don't worry though, you can sign up again using the same details from your previous account.
 Squished more of those pesky bugs!


A full list of all the upcoming changes are below:

New Feature: Solo Mode 
"Challenge Mode" name changed to "Solo Mode"
Reworked the Single Player Progression to be based on doing a set series of matches
Neighborhoods now unlock based on number of trophies acquired from completing Solo Mode matches Match Goals and Details windows Updated
Removed Advisor Challenges from Venture Tower
Skill Points Removed from game, Businesses acquired by level only
Matches in Solo Mode don't require businesses to be unlocked by level anymore
Replay will be offered to the player at end of match if they place worse than 1st

Tutorial Updates 
Changed Fortune Springs 1 Tutorial
Added Times to Fortunes Springs Matches
Removed Fortune Springs Replay
Removed Business Portfolio Tutorial
Tutorials are now replayable by replaying their associated Solo Mode Match
No longer limit building duplicate businesses in Fortune Springs
Show Investment Strategy Tutorial when player visits My Life Finance Menu for first time

Multiplayer Update 
Added Custom Time option to private matches, set between 5 and 60 minutes

UI Updates 
Updating Leaderboard and Mini-Leaderboard to be easier to read
Updated Match Start Window
Removed HQ Button from Side Bar
Hide Profit and Loss screen at end of match until Investment Tutorial is done
End of Match Leaderboard matches in-game leaderboard behaviour
Leaderboard Numbers (Units Sold, Revenue, and Valuation) format normalized
Updated Business Portfolio to reflect Skill Point removal
Removed the "Map Events" button on the main menu

Bug Fixes 
Don't allow transfers of 0
Additional Soft Lock Fixes in certain FTUE sequences
Hide Glossary Button if no entries unlocked
Updated Team Leaderboard to display correctly
Terms of Service button now links out correctly
HQ Tutorial hidden until level 15, When first HQ is given

notes.title: Update Notes for February
notes.notes:
Venture Valley is coming at you with a crazy amount of new updates and features. We have cleaned up the pesky bugs and improved game play. Test out the new update and let us know what you think!

* Avatars just got a whole lot more interesting. With the addition of new items and styles, your avatar can really stand out! 
* We've enhanced the dashboard making it easier to read and understand.
* Goodbye scrubbing floors! We’ve replaced this action with a fun new mini-game that's far less frustrating. 
* Because of recent server upgrades, User Accounts were reset. This gives players the opportunity to have a fresh new experience to Venture Valley and all its new features.

notes.title: Venture Valley Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38827951/25e8e07ccc2f9dc8bf7968718dde6c3834841a90.png

Happy Holidays from Venture Valley!  We wanted to update you on some game improvements and new features you can test out over the break.  While we know we still have a few bugs to work out (listed below), here is what you can expect with this build:

New Features

Avatar Builder: You can now create your own custom avatar from scratch! Create a look alike or make something totally unique, your avatar is completely customizable! 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38827951/b6ab2413fd537246f21d1562cf71ce48e4406881.png

Game Improvements

-  Match experience has been improved.
-  Gradual increase in difficulty as you advance, giving you an improved level of competition when you first start playing.
-  Tutorial has been shortened to give you the ability to jump into the game quicker.
-  Trophies now have cool new icons and labels.
-  Business Dashboard has been further refined and polished, although we're not done yet!
-  Fixed Spectator Mode: You can see other player's businesses in this upgrade, and we'll have a complete over-the-shoulder version in a future build.
-  Added back Host as an Observer.
-  UI / UX has been further enhanced and updated in all menus.
-  Art for Advisor animations and business interiors have been cleaned up and noticeably refined.

Known Issues

We are experiencing a Unity bug that causes the game to crash, usually during a match. This issue should only affect a small number of players, but please rest assured that you will not lose any progress. The game will automatically save your status and you can restart and resume right where you left off.  If you think you experienced this bug, we'd like to hear from you and what device you were on - you can email us at: support@venturevalleygame.com.

We just want to let you know that we are working everyday to improve Venture Valley. As we are continuing to squash bugs and optimize the game, please check back with us for updates on a regular basis. We will let you know what we have been doing to offer you the best gaming experience possible.  We now have a new build on this site.  We fixed a major server issue that was detected, and this build has also been upgraded with a few other elements.



As you continue to play Venture Valley, we appreciate any additional comments you have regarding your playing experience.  Also, if you detect any other game issues, please let us know on this site, or by emailing support@venturevalleygame.com.  Also, if you email us, we will let you know whenever we post a new build on this site.

notes.title: Venture Valley Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38827951/b8d3e403b03c844e222e82fc53e7af99a857ea38.png

We would like to start off by thanking the community for embracing our Venture Valley Early Access game build.  It has been great to see how many people have downloaded and played our game across all platforms in just one week. 

However, during this time, we’ve discovered a server bug and would like to make some small adjustments to gameplay to make it the best experience possible. While this is happening, please understand if your game crashes during this process.  We know that this can be bothersome, but know the changes will be worth the wait!  We'll post on this board as soon as the new build is working, and appreciate your patience and understanding.

If you have any questions or want to report a bug please contact us at : support@venturevalleygame.com
